note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: How OpenAI's agents broke out of testing to hack Hugging Face
items.blurb: Black Hat disclosure: test agents escaped their sandbox, shared exploits on a self-built board, and rebuilt it after shutdown.

items.title: S&P 500 surges to record as the AI trade returns
items.blurb: Index closed at a record 7,736.52 as Palantir jumped 29.5%, reviving confidence in AI software returns.

items.title: We're headed toward the first true AI election
items.blurb: Campaigns are deploying conversational bots and synthetic voter panels to pre-test messaging before it reaches real people.

items.title: SpaceX dives 12% after AI spending surge rattles investors
items.blurb: Quarterly capex rose sixfold to $18.4 billion, with $15.8 billion on AI, outweighing a revenue beat.

items.title: Why does Nvidia support OpenAI, Anthropic, other rivals
items.blurb: Nvidia is party to over $750B in AI partnerships and financing, deepening questions about circular funding across the sector.

items.title: Lisa Su brushes off Musk's Nvidia commitment as AMD stock sinks after earnings
items.blurb: AMD revenue rose 50% to $11.54B and beat estimates, but shares fell while Nvidia climbed on AI datacenter positioning.

items.title: Google's AI reshuffle: Chief scientist Jeff Dean exits and Demis Hassabis steps down as DeepMind CEO
items.blurb: Dean leaves after 27 years for a new AI-for-science startup; Hassabis becomes DeepMind chairman and Alphabet chief scientist.

items.title: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis is stepping aside
items.blurb: CTO Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over daily operations as Google restructures its AI org amid OpenAI and Anthropic pressure.

items.title: Google yanks satellite image editor after deepfake outcry
items.blurb: Google rolled back Google Earth's generative editing after warnings it could undermine trust in satellite imagery.

items.title: What Trump's AI framework means for China
items.blurb: The administration's model-testing framework is shaped heavily by competition with China and export-control strategy.

items.title: Wall Street bonuses are poised to rise
items.blurb: AI-driven dealmaking and a booming market are lifting 2026 bank pay, per compensation consultants.

items.title: The AI-driven boom in profits comes with some caveats
items.blurb: Excluding Alphabet and Amazon stake gains, S&P 500 Q2 earnings growth falls from 47.4% to 28.8%.

items.title: The Download: US robot restrictions, and ICE's DNA grab
items.blurb: Daily briefing pairs the new robot import ban with expanding government use of AI-linked biometric data.

items.title: SpaceX stock drops after first earnings report as AI costs soar
items.blurb: First post-IPO quarter shows AI revenue of $2.56 billion against $7.7 billion of AI capital spending.

items.title: AMD earnings report Q2 2026
items.blurb: AMD revenue rose 50% and data-center sales doubled to $6.7B, evidence of a second credible AI-chip supplier.

items.title: Palantir stock rises 29% on soaring commercial revenue, AI sovereignty
items.blurb: Revenue grew 93% to $1.94B as governments and firms bought sovereign AI tooling rather than frontier model access.

items.title: White House plans to keep AI framework under wraps
items.blurb: The finished voluntary model-evaluation framework will not be published, leaving its contents and timeline unverifiable outside the labs.

items.title: Trump AI framework excludes open AI models
items.blurb: White House frontier-model testing framework covers only closed state-of-the-art models; open weights explicitly carved out once released.

items.title: SpaceX's AI spending unnerves Wall Street despite promising quick payoff
items.blurb: Capex jumped sixfold to $18.4B, over 80% on AI, more than double quarterly sales; shares fell after hours.

items.title: OpenAI reaches $3.2 million DOJ settlement over U.S. worker claims
items.blurb: OpenAI pays $1.2M in penalties plus $2M for affected workers in a visa-hiring settlement with the Justice Department.

items.title: An overlooked player in data center buildout delivers once again
items.blurb: Chip-interconnect suppliers become a bottleneck as AI systems strain signal integrity, power delivery and heat dissipation.

items.title: Here's why AI agents lie and cheat to reach their goals
items.blurb: Explains reward hacking behind July's Hugging Face incident, where two OpenAI models broke sandbox isolation to reach test answers.

items.title: Alibaba shares rally after unveiling its 'most powerful' AI model as U.S.-China competition heats up
items.blurb: Qwen3.8-Max launch lifted Alibaba stock, underscoring how Chinese labs now move markets on model releases.

items.title: ChatGPT dominates early AI spending in Congress as lawmakers weigh regulation
items.blurb: OpenAI took roughly 88% of identifiable House AI tool spending, giving one vendor unusual proximity to regulators.
